The best free video editors in your browser

You can edit a video in a browser tab today. These four editors all work online for free; they differ in how far the free export goes, whether you need an account, and how many AI and stock extras you get.

We make SlopCut, one of the tools on this page. Every fact about the other tools comes from their own pages, linked under each one, as they read on 2026-10-24. Prices and features change: check each site before you choose.

How we compared them

  • Free exports without a watermark, and at what resolution
  • Account and upload: whether you must sign in and send your footage to a server
  • Editing features: timeline, transitions, titles, captions, AI and stock
  • Where it runs: browser, desktop and phone

1. SlopCut (ours)

Best for: Private, free edits up to 4K with no account and no upload, if you can live without AI and stock extras.

Good

  • Footage stays on your device: nothing is uploaded
  • Multi-track timeline, trim and split, transitions, titles and colour
  • MP4 export with WebCodecs hardware encoding, sizes from phone 1080×1920 to 4K
  • Works offline, also as a downloaded .html file

Not so good

  • Still in beta
  • No auto captions, AI tools or stock library
  • No collaboration or cloud projects: save a .slopedit file or use Slop Drive
  • MP4 export needs WebCodecs; without it, WebM is recorded in real time

Open SlopCut

2. Clipchamp

Best for: Windows users who want free 1080p exports with AI captions, voiceover and a large stock library.

Good

  • Free 1080p exports without a watermark
  • AI voiceover, subtitles in 80+ languages, noise and filler-word removal, background removal
  • Over a million royalty-free stock videos and templates
  • With a personal account, media files are not uploaded to a server for processing
  • Built into Windows 11

Not so good

  • Needs a Microsoft account and an active internet connection
  • 4K and premium stock need Microsoft 365
  • The iOS app is no longer supported from June 2026; sharing a project to edit together is for work and school accounts only

Clipchamp website · Sources: Clipchamp home, Clipchamp pricing, Clipchamp video editor, Clipchamp help: timeline, Clipchamp help: how media is processed, Clipchamp help: requirements, Clipchamp help: iOS app, Clipchamp help: sharing projects

3. CapCut

Best for: Social video with templates and AI tools, on the web, desktop and phone.

Good

  • Templates, stock media and many AI tools: auto captions, text to speech, background removal, long to short
  • Desktop apps for Windows and macOS and a mobile app
  • Cloud storage and collaboration

Not so good

  • The online editor needs an account
  • Its own pages disagree on free 4K: one says free accounts may face watermarks or bitrate limits on 4K
  • Templates, cloud sync and AI features need a connection

CapCut website · Sources: CapCut online video editor, CapCut desktop editor, CapCut pricing, CapCut desktop editor guide, CapCut help: export, CapCut help: no internet connection, CapCut for Windows

4. Kapwing

Best for: Teams that edit together in the browser and will pay for Pro.

Good

  • Shared workspaces and commenting
  • AI video generation, dubbing, voiceover and background removal
  • Templates and stock; nothing to install

Not so good

  • Free exports carry a watermark and stop at 720p
  • Free projects are kept 3 days; subtitles up to 10 minutes on the free plan
  • Cloud based: footage is uploaded

Kapwing website · Sources: Kapwing home, Kapwing pricing, Kapwing video editor, Kapwing help: is Kapwing free, Kapwing help: offline, Kapwing FAQ

Which one to choose

On this page's first two criteria, free exports without a watermark and no account or upload, SlopCut fits best: it exports up to 4K for free and your footage never leaves your device. That is why it is first.

For features, Clipchamp and CapCut are far ahead: auto captions, AI voiceover, stock libraries and templates, with free exports without a watermark, but both need an account. Kapwing is strongest for teams, and its free plan is the most limited here.

Questions

Which free online video editor has no watermark?

SlopCut, Clipchamp and the CapCut online editor export without a watermark on their free plans. Kapwing's free exports carry one.

Can I export 1080p or 4K for free?

Clipchamp exports 1080p for free and 4K with Microsoft 365. SlopCut exports up to 4K for free. CapCut exports 1080p free, and its pages disagree on free 4K. Kapwing's free plan is 720p.

Do I have to upload my videos?

With SlopCut, no: it edits the files in your browser. Clipchamp says media files are not uploaded for processing on personal accounts, and CapCut keeps projects locally unless you turn on cloud saving. Kapwing says it is cloud based.

Which has auto captions?

Clipchamp, CapCut and Kapwing (up to 10 minutes on Kapwing's free plan). SlopCut does not; Slop Transcribe can make an SRT file from the video.
